pr.body: Adds schema contracts and validation tests for the dopeTask UI/TUI data contract foundation. No UI, report, cockpit, dependency, auth metadata, workspace resolver, or runtime behavior changes.

steps.task: Inspect runtime artifact writers, existing schema conventions, source design artifacts, and ignored fixture artifacts before authoring schemas.
requirements: Use src/dopetask/ops/tp_series/logic.py as source authority for SERIES_STATE.json, EXEC.json, EXEC_ERROR.json, and SERIES_CONTEXT.json.
Use src/dopetask/router/reporting.py as source authority for ROUTE_PLAN.json.
Use out/tp_series/* and out/dopetask_route/* only as fixture examples.
Record design drift or historical shape variation honestly in proof artifacts.

steps.task: Create runtime artifact JSON Schemas and a read-only pytest fixture validation suite.
requirements: Create exactly the five requested schema files under dopetask_schemas/.
Do not create runner_health, workspace, or ui_status schemas in this packet.
Tests must read ignored fixture artifacts only and must not write to out/, proof/, or dope-agent-system.
Do not call dopetask doctor, route plan, tp series exec, or any write-side-effect command from tests.
Do not add auth_mode or bare_mode fields to exec_record.schema.json in this packet.
